inputs.input: Build a polished full login and signup page with a two-panel responsive desktop layout, clear create-account and sign-in modes, durable accounts, real secure server-validated sessions that persist across refresh, sign out that revokes the session, accessible forms, and clear validation and authentication errors
primaryWorkflows: A new user creates an account and remains signed in after refresh.
A returning user signs in, refreshes, and signs out.
A user recovers from validation or authentication errors.
requiredSurfaces: A responsive desktop two-panel page presents distinct sign-in and create-account modes and collapses into a usable mobile layout.
Submitting valid signup details creates a durable account and reaches an authenticated state.
Valid sign-in establishes a secure server-validated session and reaches the authenticated state.
Refreshing after sign-in preserves the authenticated state and account access.
Signing out revokes the active session and prevents continued authenticated access.
Invalid, duplicate, and incorrect authentication inputs show clear accessible validation or authentication errors.
The authentication journey completes without uncaught browser errors.
